note: The two sets are essentially identical in content: same nine facts plus the same tenth, differing only in capitalization and singular/plural of 'handrail(s)'. Both bind 2' - 9 1/2" to the Evacuated Solar Thermal Tubes as a height, but on the page that dimension is the FINISHED FLOOR elevation marker; the quoted string is a fabricated concatenation of two separate labels. Both also state the 1/8" cable railing dimension twice (as thickness and diameter), and both omit the finished-floor elevation as its own claim.
remarks: Both sets make the same misbinding: 2' - 9 1/2" is the FINISHED FLOOR level marker (with GRADE LEVEL 0' - 0" and SOLAR ENVELOPE 18' - 0" as the other datum markers), not a height of the solar thermal tubes. The quote 'EVACUATED SOLAR THERMAL TUBES 2' - 9 1/2"' does not appear on the page and stitches two unrelated labels together. The 1/8" steel cable railing is stated twice under two attribute names (thickness and diameter) in both sets. Both sets also leave out the finished floor elevation as a correctly bound claim and the note that tube array spacing may be larger with valves/piping not shown.
